# `jouet wait http`

- **Usage:** `jouet wait http [FLAGS] <URL>`

Wait for a URL to answer with a status, and optionally a match

Any 2xx status counts unless --status says otherwise. Redirects are followed, except when --status asks for a 3xx. --expect takes the assertions `jouet http` does, such as `jsonpath $.ready == true`, and waits until all of them hold.

## Arguments
- **`<URL>`** — The http:// or https:// URL to GET

## Flags
- **`--status <CODE>`** — The status code to wait for (default: any 2xx)
- **`--contains <REGEX>`** — Also wait until a line of the body matches REGEX, and print that line
- **`--expect <ASSERTION>`** — Also wait until ASSERTION holds, as in `jouet http --expect` (repeatable)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
